svg.title: Three sexual life cycles
svg.desc: Original schematic comparison. Animals are diploid multicellular organisms with haploid gametes. Plants and some algae alternate haploid gametophytes and diploid sporophytes. Most fungi and some protists have haploid organisms and only a diploid zygote. Teal arrows show haploid stages and terracotta arrows diploid stages. Every meiosis forks to two illustrated haploid products; every fertilization joins two gametes. Organisms and cells are not to scale.
